title_en: Koreans leave laptops in cafés — and nobody takes them ☕ #shorts
description_en:
In Korea, a café is not just a café — it's a study room. Students call it 카공 (kagong): studying in a café, one coffee, six hours. I left my laptop, my phone and my wallet on the table and went to the bathroom. Twenty minutes later, everything was still there. Nobody touches it.

Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
